bird_nest_objective_correction: The objective latch is threshold-driven, not a simple quota-zero latch. 0x800B3F50/0x800B3FBC derive the one-frame s2 progress edge; quota==1 only enables the cleanup zero at 0x800B40C4. The downstream latch store at 0x800B4100 is reached whether that cleanup branch runs or not once the threshold and once-only guards pass.
bounded_residuals: Exact live initial values for every campaign scene require a validated per-scene fixture/capsule census because actor-pool population is runtime-built.
The human-facing content-author name of flag 0x0800 is absent; its structural effect is closed as quota exclusion plus interaction/update bypass.
Pointer-indirect quota aliases loaded from RAM are outside the constant-address census.
Exact save/re-entry routing into the scene reset entry is not renamed; the reset-side reconstruction itself is pinned.
closure: Substantiated Partial and bounded-exhausted for the C04 workstream.
